other_exits: Sell position closed when CCI_Histogram buffer1==0 (bullish signal zone)
Buy position closed when CCI_Histogram buffer1==2 (bearish signal zone)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic uses CCI_Histogram custom indicator with 3 color states: buffer1==0 (bullish zone, CCI above HighLevel), buffer1==1 (neutral zone), buffer1==2 (bearish zone, CCI below LowLevel). Long entry: buffer1[1]==0 AND Col[0]>0 (was in bullish zone and still positive). Short entry: buffer1[1]==2 AND Col[0]<2 (was in bearish zone and still below 2). Signal is evaluated on bar indexed by SignalBar (default=1, previous closed bar). When SignalBar==0, intrabar recalculation is allowed (Recount logic). BuyPosOpen/SellPosClose/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose are independently toggleable via input booleans. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions which handle position existence checks internally.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate CCI_Histogram custom indicator logic (3-color histogram: above HighLevel=buffer1=0, below LowLevel=buffer1=2, between=buffer1=1). TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions must be reimplemented: position sizing with 5 margin modes, position open/close with deviation control, and GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup. Entry uses buffer index 1 (color state) and buffer index 0 (histogram value) from the custom indicator. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - 1000/2000 points = 100/200 pips on 5-digit brokers, requiring digit-adjustment awareness. Signal timestamp (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) is passed to open functions - likely used for pending order logic or signal expiry. Recount mechanism prevents stale signals on re-calculation.
